basic_details.job_title: NIPER Ahmedabad Junior Research Fellow Recruitment 2026 – Apply Online
basic_details.short_information: One Junior Research Fellow (JRF) position is open in the Department of Medicinal Chemistry, National Institute of Pharmaceutical Education and Research–Ahmedabad (NIPER-Ahmedabad), under a GSBTM funded project on EGFR homing short peptides and peptidomimetics for biofilm associated infections. The engagement is initially for 01 year, may be extended for 01 more year, and carries Rs. 23,213/- consolidated. Candidates with M. Pharm/ MS Pharm/ MSc or an equivalent PG degree can apply only through the online Google form, on or before 30 November 2026.

how_to_apply: Open the online Google form at https://forms.gle/BjcHs2GYX1P23Pju6.
Fill and submit the form on or before 30 November 2026.
Keep a copy of the submitted application, because it must be attached with the documents during verification.
Applications through any mode other than the Google form link will not be entertained.
All original certificates and relevant documents, to be produced at the time of the selection process.
A copy of the submitted application, to be attached with the documents during verification.
important_instructions: Canvassing in any form will lead to disqualification. Any further communication shall be made at [email protected]. The selected candidate will be engaged purely on a temporary basis.

content_sections.heading: NIPER Ahmedabad Junior Research Fellow at a Glance
content_sections.text: The official notification does not specify the age limit or the application fee.

rows.details: Investigating Epidermal Growth Factor Receptor (EGFR) homing – short peptides and peptidomimetics for biofilm associated infections
Initially 01 year; may be extended for 01 more year

content_sections.heading: About NIPER Ahmedabad
content_sections.text: NIPER-Ahmedabad is an institute in Ahmedabad. This post sits in its Department of Medicinal Chemistry and serves a project funded by GSBTM (Letter No.: GSBTM/0045/06/2026; PID.: 2026-27_12). The Principal Investigators are Dr. Bichismita Sahu, Professor, Dept. of Medicinal Chemistry, and Dr. Sapan Borah, Assistant Professor, Dept. of Biotechnology.

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: The minimum marks differ by category: 60% for GN/OBC candidates and 55% for SC/ST/PH candidates. Experience in organic synthesis or microbiology is listed as desired, not essential. The age limit is not specified in the notice. Candidates should check the official notification for the exact eligibility for this post.

rows.essential_qualification: M. Pharm/ MS Pharm/ MSc or Equivalent PG degree with 60% marks for GN/OBC (55% for SC/ST/PH) from UGC recognized University/ Institute, autonomous bodies NIPER/IITs/IISER.
rows.desired_work_experience: Prior experience in organic synthesis or microbiology.

content_sections.heading: Pay and Tenure
content_sections.text: Pay: Rs. 23,213/- consolidated. The position is for a period of 12 months, subject to performance and continuation of the project for the next 12 months. Any extension for 01 more year depends on the candidate's satisfactory performance and continuation of the project. The position is purely temporary in nature and co-terminus with the project.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for NIPER Ahmedabad Junior Research Fellow
content_sections.text: Open the online Google form at https://forms.gle/BjcHs2GYX1P23Pju6 . Fill and submit the form on or before 30 November 2026. Keep a copy of the submitted application, because it must be attached with the documents during verification. Applications through any mode other than the Google form link will not be entertained. Documents named in the notice: All original certificates and relevant documents, to be produced at the time of the selection process. A copy of the submitted application, to be attached with the documents during verification.

content_sections.heading: Selection and Interview
content_sections.text: Shortlisted candidates will be informed via email about the further screening process / interview. At the selection stage, candidates must produce all original certificates and relevant documents. No TA/DA will be provided for attending the interview. The notice does not mention an interview date.

content_sections.heading: Important Instructions
content_sections.text: Canvassing in any form will lead to disqualification. Any further communication shall be made at [email protected] . The selected candidate will be engaged purely on a temporary basis.
